note: Since [M] states the step for classes it constructs (Lemmas D1, D2), and [L] constructs a Directed datum with a Factor (allFactorWithTreasuryPeriod) whose Program is proved by Factor.worksNow, the hypotheses of programs are supplied by the construction; the remaining differences are that the step is the advances field of Program/Issues for an existentially chosen construction, R is Move/Relays, and the drift bound is the abstract params(m+1).drift.

structure Program (B : Directed G I Z K P) : Prop where
  begins N p : ∃ F, Curve (B.a.budget N) (n:=B.a.S.side N p) F (band B.a N) ∧
      ∀ β∈band B.a N,(F β).beta=β ∧ Lives B.bake N N p (F β) ∧ B.bake.Starter N p (F β)
  advances N p (m : ℕ) : m < N →
    ∀ l u : ℝ, l ≤ u → ∀ Q, Curve (B.a.budget (m+1)) Q (Set.Icc l u) →
      (∀ x∈ Set.Icc l u, Lives B.bake N (m+1) p (Q x) ∧ (Q x).beta ∈ band B.a (m+1)) →
      ∃ T, Curve (B.a.budget m) T (Set.Icc l u) ∧
        ∀ x∈ Set.Icc l u,B.Move N m p (T x) (Q x)
